Settings used for this import
—
—
1 Import a schedule Required
Data date
The P6 export's own as-of date. Drives week placement and float health. Defaults to the previous Friday.
Report date, as printed or issued
Defaults to today. Drives the now column highlight in the grid.
Schedule file
Excel or CSV. Paste the export instead if the file will not open.
Phase 1, schedule in isolation. Deliverable rows are derived from activity-name stems; hours and weights are derived, not MDL.
2 Map columns Once a file loads
3 Date range Once a file loads
Board span
Left blank, the board spans the imported schedule's own earliest and latest dates. Set either field to hold it to a narrower window instead. Activities outside the range are listed under Diagnostics rather than dropped silently.
4 Source Once a file loads
Source name
Defaults to the file name. Shown in the Source Schedule column and the Source filter, and editable later from the Sources tab.
Mode
Thresholds
Health calculation, independent of how a schedule was imported.
CRIT float at or below
Total float in days at which a deliverable reads as critical.
RISK float at or below
Total float in days at which a deliverable reads as at risk.
Parsing
How an export is read. Set once and rarely changed.
Week ends on
Sets the board's week columns, the week-range picker and the week filter. Changing it re-buckets every milestone into the new weeks; comments and edits are unaffected.
⚠ Diagnostics (0)
Show on screen
Marks the rows and milestones each entry points at, directly on the board.
Getting around
  • Left rail, your annotations: comments and markups, and your own milestones.
  • This panel, the schedule and its format: view controls, sources, import and data settings.
  • On the board: click a milestone to open its card; double-click a week cell to add a milestone on that row.
  • Esc closes the topmost panel or card.
